summary: As of 2026-10-01, the claim that Builder.ai entered insolvency proceedings in 2025 is TRUE with 82% confidence. The company, legally known as Builder.ai (formerly Engineer.ai Corporation), is a smartphone application development firm founded in 2016 and based mainly in the UK and US. Multiple sources confirm that in May 2025 Builder.ai announced insolvency after creditors seized significant borrowed funds.
